description: vllm-project/semantic-router: /accept gate, then /assign; workgroup claim board. An /accept counts from an OWNER or COLLABORATOR, or from anyone once the bot has applied `accepted` to an issue you filed (it checks the commenter's access first; maintainers comment as MEMBER). For a tighter gate, copy this pack to your packs dir and list the maintainer logins in authorized_by.logins.

label_transitions.alert: IN-PROGRESS label missing: ask a maintainer once, in one line naming the cause
NEEDS REBASE (the bot's label): merge main into the branch

messages.assigned: ASSIGNED to you: implementation may start
messages.competing_pr: COMPETING PR #{number} (by @{author}) says Closes #{target}: check scope before /assign
